Personal Portfolio. One project from the course. 72 marks, 50%.
Externally Set Assignment: Pearson theme, preparatory studies, then a 10-hour supervised exam. 72 marks, 50%.
Each AO is marked out of 18. Four AOs make 72 marks per component.

Development work before the final piece. In Component 2, mounted on three A2 sheets, one side, no overlapping. Essential: marks are lost if missing.

cards.f: What help may a teacher give in the 10-hour exam?
cards.b: Technical help only (space, materials, equipment). No direction or demonstration.

cards.f: Why is 'ideas consolidated too early' a weakness?
cards.b: You stopped exploring too soon, so there are few experiments, little review and the idea is not fully realised (AO2).

gaps.s: Each assessment objective is marked out of ___.
The externally set assignment exam lasts ___ hours.
Recording from observation is assessed in AO___.
Experimenting with media is assessed in AO___.
Preparatory studies are mounted on three sheets of ___ paper.
Mark band 3 is described as emerging ___ ability.

short.model: It rewards developing ideas through investigating real sources, such as artists, and showing critical understanding of why they matter to your own idea.
points: critical understanding linked to own ideas

short.q: Explain why the preparatory studies matter in the externally set assignment.
short.model: They are an essential part of the exam and show AO1–AO3. Marks are lost if they are not submitted.
points: evidence of AO1–AO3 / marks lost if missing

short.q: What does 'safe' mean in the Band 3 descriptor and how could you move up?
short.model: It means staying in your comfort zone with simple, deliberate work. Take risks, try varied media and review and refine ideas.

short.q: State two rules for the 10-hour exam.
short.model: It is under formal supervision, can be split over up to four sessions in three weeks, and teachers give technical help only.
points: max four sessions / no teacher direction

short.q: A final piece is excellent but the sketchbook is thin. Which AOs suffer?
short.model: AO1, AO2 and AO3 suffer, because they are judged on development and recording; only AO4 mainly rewards the final piece.
points: AO4 is about the final piece
